Contract ManageBookCopyCRUDService::addBookCopy(callNo: String,barcode: String,location: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		bookCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode),
		book: Book = Book.allInstance()->any(o|o.CallNo = callNo)
	precondition:
		book.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		Book.allInstance()->includes(book) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->excludes(bookCopy)
	postcondition:
		let newBookCopy: BookCopy in
		newBookCopy.oclIsNew() and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(newBookCopy) and
		newBookCopy.Barcode = barcode and
		newBookCopy.Location = location and
		result = true
}
